trailhead.label: By the Völser Bach below Ums, where paths 2 and 8 meet

cautions: About 1.6 km on quiet asphalt lanes between the farms, where a car or tractor may pass: keep your dog on a short lead there.
Two crossings of the Umser Straße, at the Schlernstraße and by the church in Ums: cross with care.
Farmed meadows line much of the loop: Völs keeps dogs off them.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
